claims.statement: Agni is the Hindu god of fire.
claims.statement_id: Agni adalah dewa api dalam tradisi Hindu.
claims.quote: Agni is the Hindu god of fire.

claims.statement: Agni is regarded as a friend and protector of humans and the home.
claims.statement_id: Agni dipandang sebagai sahabat serta pelindung manusia dan rumah.
claims.quote: He is regarded as the friend and protector of humanity, in particular, he safeguards the home.

claims.statement: Agni is associated with sacrificial and domestic fire, the sun, lightning, funeral fire, and digestive fire.
claims.statement_id: Agni dihubungkan dengan api persembahan dan rumah, matahari, petir, api kremasi, serta api pencernaan.
claims.quote: Various forms of fire are associated with Agni and include the sun, lightning, comets, sacrificial fire, domestic fires, the fire of the funeral pyre, and the digestive fire which is within all humans.

claims.statement: Agni was especially important in the Vedic period and received many hymns in the Vedas.
claims.statement_id: Agni terutama penting pada zaman Weda dan menerima banyak himne dalam Weda.
claims.quote: Agni was especially important in the Vedic period (1500-500 BCE), and the Vedas contains more hymns to him than to any other deity.

claims.statement: Agni is understood as a witness to important acts, and fire is used in Hindu ceremonies such as weddings.
claims.statement_id: Agni dipandang sebagai saksi tindakan penting; api digunakan dalam upacara Hindu seperti pernikahan.
claims.quote: Agni knows the thoughts of all people and is a witness to all important actions, hence the use of fire in many important Hindu ceremonies such as marriages.

claims.statement: Agni is believed to carry human offerings to the gods through sacrificial fire.
claims.statement_id: Agni diyakini membawa persembahan manusia kepada para dewa melalui api kurban.
claims.quote: Agni is perhaps most closely associated with sacrificial fires where he is thought to carry the offerings of humans to the gods.

claims.statement: One version says frogs, elephants, and parrots betrayed Agni's hiding places and he distorted their speech.
claims.statement_id: Salah satu versi kisah menyebut katak, gajah, dan nuri membocorkan tempat persembunyian Agni, lalu ia mengubah suara mereka.
claims.quote: In another version it is frogs, then elephants, and then parrots which reveal Agni's attempts at hiding and the god punished them all by distorting their speech ever after.

claims.statement: In art, Agni is often shown with dark skin, two heads, four arms, and a goat mount.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni, Agni kerap ditampilkan berkulit gelap, berkepala dua, berlengan empat, dan menunggang kambing.
claims.quote: In art, Agni is often depicted with black skin, two heads, four arms, and riding either a goat

claims.statement: Agni's two heads symbolize domestic and sacrificial fire.
claims.statement_id: Dua kepala Agni melambangkan api rumah dan api kurban.
claims.quote: His two heads, which spout flames, are symbolic of his association with two types of fire: the domestic hearth and the sacrificial fire.

claims.statement: Agni guards the southeast direction.
claims.statement_id: Agni menjaga arah tenggara sebagai salah satu penjaga arah.
claims.quote: Agni protects the south-east quarter, Purajyotisa.

claims.statement: A museum essay names Agni as the god of fire and says the religion known today as Hinduism has its roots in these ancient texts.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah esai museum menyebut Agni sebagai dewa api dan menyatakan bahwa agama yang kini dikenal sebagai Hinduisme berakar pada teks-teks kuno.
claims.quote: and Agni, the god of fire. The religion known today as Hinduism has its roots in these ancient texts.

claims.statement: The first Rig Veda hymn praises Agni as priest and minister of sacrifice.
claims.statement_id: Himne pertama Rig Weda memuji Agni sebagai imam dan pelayan kurban.
claims.quote: THE HYMNS OF THE RIGVEDA. BOOK THE FIRST. HYMN I. Agni. I laud Agni, the chosen Priest, God, minister of sacrifice,

claims.statement: The hymn calls Agni worthy of praise by living people and ancient seers.
claims.statement_id: Himne itu menyebut Agni layak dipuji oleh orang hidup dan para resi terdahulu.
claims.quote: Worthy is Agni to be praised by living as by ancient seers

claims.statement: The hymn calls Agni ruler of sacrifices and guardian of eternal law.
claims.statement_id: Himne itu menyebut Agni penguasa kurban dan penjaga hukum abadi.
claims.quote: Ruler of sacrifices, guard of Law eternal, radiant One,

claims.statement: In some myths Karttikeya (Skanda), the Hindu god of war, is Agni's son, the result of Agni's conquest of the Pleiades, the wives of the Seven Sages.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sebagian mitos, Karttikeya (Skanda), dewa perang Hindu, adalah putra Agni, hasil penaklukan Agni atas Pleiades, para istri Tujuh Resi.
claims.quote: In some myths, Karttikeya (Skanda), the Hindu god of war, is Agni's son and the result of Agni's conquest of the Pleiades, the wives of the Seven Sages.

claims.statement: Agni is the son of the Celestial Waters, an element closely connected with fire, which is thought to be carried down to earth within rain.
claims.statement_id: Agni adalah putra Air Surgawi, unsur yang berkaitan erat dengan api yang dianggap dibawa turun ke bumi dalam hujan.
claims.quote: Agni is the son of the Celestial Waters, and that element is closely connected with fire which is thought to be carried down to earth within rain.

claims.statement: Agni is also responsible for lightning, which is born from the god's union with the cloud goddess.
claims.statement_id: Agni juga bertanggung jawab atas petir, yang lahir dari persatuan sang dewa dengan dewi awan.
claims.quote: Agni is also responsible for lightning which is born from the god's union with the cloud goddess.

claims.statement: Agni is also associated with the funeral pyre; in this role he leads the dead to their final judgement by Yama, ruler of the Underworld.
claims.statement_id: Agni juga dikaitkan dengan api pembakaran jenazah; dalam peran ini ia menuntun orang mati ke penghakiman akhir oleh Yama, penguasa Dunia Bawah.
claims.quote: Another fire Agni is associated with is the funeral pyre; in this role, he leads the dead to their final judgement by Yama, ruler of the Underworld.

claims.statement: According to various myths, Agni was at first afraid to take on this duty because his three brothers had already been killed performing it; he hid in the subterranean waters, but fish revealed his hiding place to the gods, so Agni cursed them to become the easy prey of men.
claims.statement_id: Menurut berbagai mitos, Agni mula-mula takut mengemban tugas itu karena tiga saudaranya sudah terbunuh saat menjalankannya; ia bersembunyi di perairan bawah tanah, tetapi ikan membocorkan tempatnya kepada para dewa, sehingga Agni mengutuk ikan menjadi mangsa mudah manusia.
claims.quote: According to various myths, Agni was at first afraid to take on this duty as his three brothers had been killed already whilst performing the task. Consequently, Agni hid in the subterranean waters but, unfortunately, fish revealed his hiding place to the gods. As a result, Agni cursed them so that fish would become the easy prey of men.

claims.statement: In this version Agni's final hiding place was inside a sami tree, which is therefore considered the sacred abode of fire in Hindu rituals, and its sticks are used to make fires.
claims.statement_id: Dalam versi ini, tempat persembunyian terakhir Agni adalah di dalam pohon sami, sehingga pohon itu dianggap tempat suci api dalam ritual Hindu dan rantingnya dipakai untuk membuat api.
claims.quote: The final hiding place of Agni in this version was inside a sami tree and so it is considered the sacred abode of fire in Hindu rituals and its sticks are used to make fires.

claims.statement: Agni negotiated compensation in the form of a share of the sacrifice he carried to the gods, and he was given the boon of ever-lasting life.
claims.statement_id: Agni menegosiasikan kompensasi berupa bagian tetap dari kurban yang ia bawa kepada para dewa, dan ia dianugerahi hidup abadi.
claims.quote: Agni did negotiate by way of compensation to always receive a share of the sacrifice he carried to the gods and he was given the boon of ever-lasting life.

claims.statement: In the Brhaddevata we are told that at one point Agni is dismembered and distributed among earthly things.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Brhaddevata diceritakan bahwa pada suatu ketika Agni dipotong-potong dan dibagikan kepada benda-benda duniawi.
claims.quote: In the Brhaddevata we are told that at one point Agni is dismembered and distributed among earthly things.

claims.statement: Over time Agni's importance as a god diminishes, which the Mahabharata explains as due to his overindulgence in consuming one too many offerings.
claims.statement_id: Seiring waktu pentingnya Agni sebagai dewa berkurang, yang dalam Mahabharata dijelaskan sebagai akibat kelewat banyak menyantap persembahan.
claims.quote: Over time Agni's importance as a god diminishes, a fact explained in the Mahabharata as due to his overindulgence in consuming one too many offerings.

claims.statement: In a Rigveda hymn Agni has two wickedly sharp iron tusks and devours his victims without mercy, but when called upon by the gods he destroys the raksasa with his flaming spears.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sebuah himne Rigweda, Agni memiliki dua taring besi yang sangat tajam dan melahap korbannya tanpa belas kasihan, tetapi ketika dipanggil para dewa ia membinasakan para raksasa dengan tombak apinya.
claims.quote: Agni, according to one Rigveda hymn attributed to the sage Vasistha, also has a darker side. Similar in nature to the 'flesh-eater' demons, the raksasa, he has two wickedly sharp iron tusks and he devours his victims without mercy. However, when called upon by the gods, Agni destroys the raksasa with his flaming spears.

claims.statement: In sacred texts such as the Mahabharata Agni is also called the "Oblation-devourer" and the "Purifier".
claims.statement_id: Dalam kitab suci seperti Mahabharata, Agni juga disebut "Pelahap Persembahan" dan "Pemurni".
claims.quote: He is also referred to in sacred texts such as the Mahabharata as the 'Oblation-devourer' and the 'Purifier'.

claims.statement: In Hindu art Agni typically carries a fan used to build up fires, a sacrificial ladle, an axe, and a flaming torch or javelin.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni Hindu Agni biasanya membawa kipas untuk membesarkan api, sendok kurban, kapak, serta obor menyala atau lembing.
claims.quote: Typically he carries a fan (which he uses to build up fires), a sacrificial ladle, an axe, and a flaming torch or javelin.

claims.statement: In the Visnu Purana Agni is described as the eldest son of Brahma, and Svaha is his wife.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Visnu Purana, Agni digambarkan sebagai putra sulung Brahma, dan Svaha adalah istrinya.
claims.quote: In the Visnu Purana he is described as the eldest son of Brahma and Svaha is his wife.

claims.statement: In later Hindu art Agni is also represented as one of the Dikpalas, the eight guardians of the directions of space.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni Hindu yang lebih kemudian, Agni juga digambarkan sebagai salah satu Dikpala, delapan penjaga arah ruang.
claims.quote: In later Hindu art, Agni is also represented as one of the Dikpalas who were the eight guardians of the directions of space.

claims.statement: Agni is still considered today to be omnipresent though not directly worshipped.
claims.statement_id: Hingga kini Agni masih dianggap hadir di mana-mana, meski tidak dipuja secara langsung.
claims.quote: He is still considered today omnipresent though not directly worshipped.

claims.statement: A hymn calls Agni the messenger and herald, master of all wealth, well skilled in sacrifice.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah himne menyebut Agni sebagai utusan dan pewarta, tuan segala kekayaan, yang terampil dalam kurban.
claims.quote: WE choose Agni the messenger, the herald, master of all wealth, Well skilled in this our sacrifice.

claims.statement: Agni is asked to bring the Gods to the sacrifice and is called the herald, meet for praise.
claims.statement_id: Agni diminta membawa para dewa ke tempat kurban dan disebut pewarta yang layak dipuji.
claims.quote: Bring the Gods hither, Agni, born for him who strews the sacred grass: Thou art our herald, meet for praise.

claims.statement: Agni is invoked as Lord of the House and Oblation-bearer, much beloved.
claims.statement_id: Agni diseru sebagai Penguasa Rumah dan Pembawa Persembahan yang sangat dicintai.
claims.quote: With callings ever they invoke Agni, Agni, Lord of the House, Oblation-bearer, much beloved.

claims.statement: Agni is asked to burn up the enemies whom fiends protect.
claims.statement_id: Agni diminta membakar habis musuh-musuh para pemuja yang dilindungi oleh para iblis.
claims.quote: O Agni, radiant One, to whom the holy oil is poured, burn up Our enemies whom fiends protect.

claims.statement: Hathor is an ancient Egyptian goddess.
claims.statement_id: Hathor adalah dewi Mesir kuno.
claims.quote: Hathor is an ancient Egyptian goddess

claims.statement: Hathor may be depicted as a cow or a woman with a cow head or ears.
claims.statement_id: Hathor dapat digambarkan sebagai sapi atau perempuan dengan kepala maupun telinga sapi.
claims.quote: She is usually depicted as a woman with the head of a cow, ears of a cow, or simply in cow form.

claims.statement: Hathor's name is explained as 'Domain of Horus' or 'Temple of Horus'.
claims.statement_id: Nama Hathor diterangkan sebagai 'Wilayah Horus' atau 'Kuil Horus'.
claims.quote: Her name means "Domain of Horus" or "Temple of Horus"

claims.statement: The sistrum is Hathor's instrument, used in the story to drive away evil.
claims.statement_id: Sistrum adalah alat musik Hathor yang dalam kisah dipakai untuk mengusir kejahatan.
claims.quote: The sistrum is her instrument which she used to drive evil from the land and inspire goodness.

claims.statement: Hathor is a patron goddess of joy, celebration, and love.
claims.statement_id: Hathor menaungi sukacita, perayaan, dan cinta.
claims.quote: She is the patron goddess of joy, celebration, and love

claims.statement: Hathor was associated with women and their physical and mental health.
claims.statement_id: Hathor berkaitan dengan perempuan dan kesehatan fisik maupun batin mereka.
claims.quote: She was always, from the earliest times, associated with women and women's health in body and in mind.

claims.statement: In the Heavenly Cow story, Hathor's destructive fury becomes Sekhmet.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah Sapi Surgawi, amarah Hathor berubah menjadi wujud Sekhmet yang merusak.
claims.quote: Hathor descends on the world in a fury of destruction, killing everyone she finds and toppling their cities, crushing their homes and tearing up fields and gardens and so transforms into the goddess Sekhmet.

claims.statement: After becoming drunk and sleeping, she wakes as benevolent Hathor.
claims.statement_id: Setelah mabuk dan tertidur, ia bangun kembali sebagai Hathor yang baik hati.
claims.quote: She becomes drunk, falls asleep, and wakes up as Hathor the benevolent.

claims.statement: Hathor's cult center was at Dendera, but she was worshipped across Egypt.
claims.statement_id: Pusat pemujaan Hathor berada di Dendera, tetapi ia dipuja di seluruh Mesir.
claims.quote: Hathor's cult center was at Dendera, Egypt, but she was widely regarded and worshipped throughout Egypt.

claims.statement: Early Hathor worship used a cow form, sometimes with stars above her.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa awal Hathor dipuja dalam bentuk sapi atau sapi dengan bintang di atasnya.
claims.quote: Hathor was, in early times, worshipped in the form of a cow or as a cow with stars above her.

claims.statement: A metal plaque depicts Hathor as a cow with a sun disk between its horns.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah plak logam menampilkan Hathor sebagai sapi bertanduk dengan cakram matahari.
claims.quote: This metal plaque depicts a cow with a sundisk between its horns, which is a common representation of the goddess Hathor.

claims.statement: The plaque was excavated near a Hathor shrine at Deir el-Bahari.
claims.statement_id: Plak itu ditemukan dekat tempat pemujaan Hathor di Deir el-Bahari.
claims.quote: The piece was excavated at Deir el-Bahari, close to a shrine for this goddess.

claims.statement: Hathor was said to protect and nurse infant Horus and was worshipped in the Shaking of the Papyrus ritual.
claims.statement_id: Hathor disebut menyusui dan melindungi Horus bayi serta dipuja dalam ritual Mengguncang Papirus.
claims.quote: Horus was protected and nursed while a baby by the goddess Hathor, who was worshipped in the ritual of the Shaking of the Papyrus.

claims.statement: Sistrum and menat were rattled in Hathor's cult to evoke rustling papyrus.
claims.statement_id: Sistrum dan menat dipakai dalam ritual Hathor untuk meniru bunyi papirus bergesek.
claims.quote: Hathor’s primary cult instruments, the sistrum (68.44) and the menat (11.215.450), were rattled to produce a comparable rustling sound and evoke this mythical environment.

claims.statement: Hathor is also shown as a cow emerging from a papyrus thicket.
claims.statement_id: Hathor juga digambarkan sebagai sapi yang keluar dari rumpun papirus.
claims.quote: this goddess is shown in the form of a cow emerging from the papyrus thicket

claims.statement: In the Book of the Heavenly Cow, Hathor descends on the world in a fury of destruction, killing everyone she finds, toppling cities, crushing homes and tearing up fields and gardens, and so becomes Sekhmet.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Kitab Sapi Surgawi, Hathor turun ke dunia dalam amukan kehancuran: ia membunuh semua orang yang ditemuinya, meruntuhkan kota, menghancurkan rumah, dan mencabut ladang serta kebun, lalu menjadi Sekhmet.
claims.quote: Hathor descends on the world in a fury of destruction, killing everyone she finds and toppling their cities, crushing their homes and tearing up fields and gardens and so transforms into the goddess Sekhmet.

claims.statement: The other gods point out that Sekhmet is going too far in this "lesson" and that soon no human beings will be left on earth.
claims.statement_id: Para dewa lain menegur bahwa Sekhmet berlebihan dalam "pelajaran" itu, sebab tak lama lagi tidak akan ada manusia yang tersisa di bumi.
claims.quote: They point out that Sekhmet is going too far in teaching this "lesson" to humanity and how, soon, there will be no human beings left on earth to benefit from it.

claims.statement: Sekhmet, crazed with thirst for blood, drinks the blood-red beer, becomes drunk, falls asleep and wakes as the benevolent Hathor.
claims.statement_id: Sekhmet yang haus darah meminum bir merah, mabuk, tertidur, dan bangun sebagai Hathor yang murah hati.
claims.quote: Sekhmet, by this time, is crazed with the thirst for more blood and, when she comes upon the blood-red beer, she quickly seizes it and begins drinking. She becomes drunk, falls asleep, and wakes up as Hathor the benevolent.

claims.statement: A scholarly summary of the Book of the Heavenly Cow: Hathor is chosen by Ra to act as the violent Eye of Ra to punish humanity, which she does by slaughtering the rebels and bringing death into the world.
claims.statement_id: Ringkasan ilmiah Kitab Sapi Surgawi: Hathor dipilih Ra sebagai Mata Ra yang garang untuk menghukum manusia, dan ia melakukannya dengan membantai para pemberontak serta membawa kematian ke dunia.
claims.quote: After Ra consulting with the other gods, the goddess Hathor is chosen by Ra to act as the violent Eye of Ra. She was to deliver divine punishment to humanity and did so by slaughtering the rebels and bringing death into the world.

claims.statement: Divine punishment was inflicted through Hathor, and the survivors suffered separation from Ra, who now lived in the sky on the back of Nut, the heavenly cow.
claims.statement_id: Hukuman ilahi dijatuhkan lewat Hathor; para penyintas menderita karena terpisah dari Ra, yang sejak itu tinggal di langit di punggung Nut, sapi surgawi.
claims.quote: Divine punishment was inflicted through the goddess Hathor, with the survivors suffering through separation from Ra, who now resided in the sky on the back of Nut, the heavenly cow.

claims.statement: According to Egyptologist Geraldine Pinch, Hathor was the golden goddess who helped women to give birth, the dead to be reborn, and the cosmos to be renewed.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Egyptolog Geraldine Pinch, Hathor adalah dewi keemasan yang membantu perempuan melahirkan, orang mati dilahirkan kembali, dan kosmos diperbarui.
claims.quote: Hathor was the golden goddess who helped women to give birth, the dead to be reborn, and the cosmos to be renewed.

claims.statement: Hathor is described as the primordial Mother Goddess, ruler of the sky, the sun, the moon, agriculture, fertility, the east, the west, moisture and childbirth.
claims.statement_id: Hathor digambarkan sebagai Dewi Ibu purba, penguasa langit, matahari, bulan, pertanian, kesuburan, timur, barat, kelembapan, dan kelahiran.
claims.quote: She was the primordial Mother Goddess, ruler of the sky, the sun, the moon, agriculture, fertility, the east, the west, moisture and childbirth.

claims.statement: The Seven Hathors were present at the birth of a human being and decreed their fate.
claims.statement_id: Tujuh Hathor hadir pada kelahiran seorang manusia dan menetapkan nasibnya.
claims.quote: The most important of these were the Seven Hathors who were present at the birth of a human being and decreed their fate.

claims.statement: The Seven Hathors had a red ribbon which they used to bind evil forces and dark demons.
claims.statement_id: Tujuh Hathor memiliki pita merah yang mereka pakai untuk mengikat kekuatan jahat dan iblis gelap.
claims.quote: The Seven Hathors shared these attributes but also had a red ribbon which they used to bind evil forces and dark demons.

claims.statement: In a Late Period story, Hathor rules the underworld, emerging to punish those who behave unjustly on earth.
claims.statement_id: Dalam sebuah kisah Periode Akhir, Hathor memerintah dunia bawah dan muncul untuk menghukum mereka yang bertindak tidak adil di bumi.
claims.quote: In a Late Period story, Hathor rules the underworld, emerging to punish those who behave unjustly on earth.

claims.statement: Women among the dead who were deemed worthy to cross assumed Hathor's likeness and qualities, while the male dead continued to be associated with Osiris.
claims.statement_id: Perempuan yang meninggal dan dinilai layak menyeberang ke Ladang Buluh mengambil rupa dan sifat Hathor, sedangkan laki-laki yang meninggal tetap dihubungkan dengan Osiris.
claims.quote: the female dead who were deemed worthy to cross ... assumed Hathor's likeness and qualities while the male dead continued to be associated with Osiris.

claims.statement: In the story of the sun god's voyage through the night sky and the underworld, Hathor stands in the prow keeping watch for any sign of danger from Apophis.
claims.statement_id: Dalam kisah pelayaran dewa matahari melintasi langit malam dan dunia bawah, Hathor berdiri di haluan dan berjaga dari tanda bahaya yang datang dari Apophis.
claims.quote: In the story of the sun god's voyage through the night sky and the underworld, Hathor stands in the prow keeping watch for any sign of danger from Apophis.

claims.statement: Hathor came to be identified with the Distant Goddess; when the goddess returned she brought the inundation with her, but had to be pacified with music, dancing, feasting and drunkenness.
claims.statement_id: Hathor dikenali dengan Dewi yang Jauh; ketika sang dewi kembali, ia membawa banjir tahunan, tetapi harus diredakan dengan musik, tarian, pesta, dan mabuk.
claims.quote: Hathor was widely worshipped and came to be idenified with a deity known as The Distant Goddess. ... When the Distant Goddess returned, she brought the inundation with her, but she had to be pacified with music, dancing, feasting, and drunkenness.

claims.statement: Helios is the Greek sun god.
claims.statement_id: Helios adalah dewa matahari dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: Helios (also Helius) was the god of the Sun in Greek mythology.

claims.statement: Helios drove a golden chariot bearing the sun from east to west each day.
claims.statement_id: Helios mengendarai kereta emas yang membawa matahari dari timur ke barat setiap hari.
claims.quote: Helios rode a golden chariot which brought the Sun across the skies each day from the east (Ethiopia) to the west (Hesperides).

claims.statement: Helios is the child of the Titans Hyperion and Theia.
claims.statement_id: Helios adalah anak pasangan Titan Hyperion dan Theia.
claims.quote: In Greek mythology, Helios is the offspring of the titans Hyperion and Theia.

claims.statement: Helios's sisters are Selene the moon and Eos the dawn.
claims.statement_id: Saudari Helios adalah Selene sang bulan dan Eos sang fajar.
claims.quote: His sisters were Selene (the Moon) and Eos (Dawn).

claims.statement: Phaethon is the son of Helios and Clymene.
claims.statement_id: Phaethon adalah putra Helios dan Clymene.
claims.quote: Helios is also the father of Phaethon, whose mother was Clymene.

claims.statement: Phaethon lost control of Helios's horses, and Zeus struck him with lightning to avert a worldwide fire.
claims.statement_id: Phaethon gagal mengendalikan kuda kereta Helios; Zeus menyambarnya dengan petir agar bumi tidak terbakar.
claims.quote: Phaethon proved unable to control Helios' wild horses, and when he spun out of control, Zeus was obliged to strike down Phaethon with a thunderbolt lest he set the whole world on fire.

claims.statement: After Odysseus's crew ate his cattle, Helios asked Zeus to punish them.
claims.statement_id: Setelah ternaknya dimakan awak Odysseus, Helios meminta Zeus menghukum mereka.
claims.quote: In vengeance, Helios enlisted the help of Zeus who destroyed the ship and drowned Odysseus' crew for their impiety.

claims.statement: The worship of Helios was important on Rhodes.
claims.statement_id: Pemujaan Helios sangat penting di Rhodes.
claims.quote: The one place in Greece where the worship of Helios was important was on Rhodes.

claims.statement: The Halieia games on Rhodes honored Helios.
claims.statement_id: Pertandingan Halieia di Rhodes diselenggarakan untuk menghormati Helios.
claims.quote: In honour of Helios, Panhellenic games, the Halieia, were held on the island every five years

claims.statement: In Roman contexts Helios was also known as Sol.
claims.statement_id: Dalam konteks Romawi, Helios dikenal pula sebagai Sol.
claims.quote: The Romans went one step further and made Helios, also known as Sol, an important cult god.

claims.statement: Theoi describes Helios as a Titan sun god, guardian of oaths, and god of sight.
claims.statement_id: Theoi menyebut Helios dewa matahari dari golongan Titan, penjaga sumpah, dan dewa penglihatan.
claims.quote: HELIOS (Helius) was the Titan god of the sun, a guardian of oaths, and the god of sight.

claims.statement: Helios appears at dawn with a solar aureole and a chariot drawn by four winged horses.
claims.statement_id: Helios muncul setiap fajar dengan mahkota cahaya dan kereta empat kuda bersayap.
claims.quote: he emerged each dawn, crowned with the aureole of the sun, driving a chariot drawn by four winged steeds.

claims.statement: A Greek vase identifies Helios by writing his name in ancient Greek letters.
claims.statement_id: Sebuah vas Yunani menamai sosok Helios dalam huruf Yunani kuno.
claims.quote: We can tell who Helios is on this vase because the artist wrote his name above, in ancient Greek letters.

claims.statement: Ancient Greeks imagined a great stream called Ocean encircling the earth.
claims.statement_id: Orang Yunani kuno membayangkan arus besar bernama Ocean mengelilingi bumi.
claims.quote: The ancient Greeks believed that there was a great, wide, flowing stream that surrounded the earth. They called the stream Ocean.

claims.statement: Helios dwelt in a golden palace in the River Okeanos (Oceanus) at the far ends of the earth, from which he emerged each dawn.
claims.statement_id: Helios tinggal di istana emas di Sungai Okeanos di ujung bumi, tempat ia muncul setiap fajar.
claims.quote: He dwelt in a golden palace in the River Okeanos (Oceanus) at the far ends of the earth from which he emerged each dawn

claims.statement: On reaching the land of the Hesperides in the far West, Helios descended into a golden cup that bore him through the northern streams of Okeanos back to his rising place in the East.
claims.statement_id: Sesampainya di negeri Hesperides di barat jauh, Helios turun ke dalam cawan emas yang membawanya melalui aliran utara Okeanos kembali ke tempat terbitnya di timur.
claims.quote: When he reached the the land of the Hesperides in the far West he descended into a golden cup which bore him through the northern streams of Okeanos back to his rising place in the East.

claims.statement: His son Phaethon once tried to drive the chariot of the sun but lost control and set the earth ablaze; Zeus struck the boy down with a thunderbolt.
claims.statement_id: Putranya, Phaethon, pernah mencoba mengendarai kereta matahari, tetapi kehilangan kendali dan membakar bumi; Zeus menjatuhkan anak itu dengan petir.
claims.quote: Once his son Phaethon tried to drive the chariot of the sun, but he lost control and set the earth ablaze. Zeus struck the boy down with a thunderbolt.

claims.statement: Helios was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless man in purple robes, crowned with the shining aureole of the sun.
claims.statement_id: Helios digambarkan sebagai pria tampan, biasanya tak berjanggut, berjubah ungu dan bermahkota lingkar cahaya matahari.
claims.quote: Helios was depicted as a handsome, usually beardless, man clothed in purple robes and crowned with the shining aureole of the sun.

claims.statement: Helios was identified with several other gods of fire and light such as Hephaistos (Hephaestus) and Phoibos Apollon (Phoebus Apollo).
claims.statement_id: Helios diidentifikasi dengan beberapa dewa api dan cahaya lain seperti Hephaistos dan Phoibos Apollon.
claims.quote: Helios was identified with several other gods of fire and light such as Hephaistos (Hephaestus) and light-bringing Phoibos Apollon (Phoebus Apollo).

claims.statement: Even in the Homeric poems Helios is described as the god who sees and hears everything, yet he is unaware that the companions of Odysseus robbed his oxen until informed by Lampetia.
claims.statement_id: Bahkan dalam puisi Homerik Helios digambarkan sebagai dewa yang melihat dan mendengar segalanya, tetapi ia tidak tahu bahwa kawan-kawan Odysseus mencuri sapinya sampai diberi tahu oleh Lampetia.
claims.quote: Helios is described even in the Homeric poems as the god who sees and hears every thing, but, notwithstanding this, he is unaware of the fact that the companions of Odysseus robbed his oxen, until he was informed of it by Lampetia.

claims.statement: Owing to his omniscience, Helios was able to betray to Hephaestus the faithlessness of Aphrodite and to reveal to Demeter the carrying off of her daughter.
claims.statement_id: Karena kemahatahuannya, Helios dapat membongkar kepada Hephaestus ketidaksetiaan Aphrodite dan memberi tahu Demeter tentang penculikan putrinya.
claims.quote: But, owing to his omniscience, he was able to betray to Hephaestus the faithlessness of Aphrodite, and to reveal to Demeter the carrying off of her daughter.

claims.statement: The island of Thrinacia (Sicily) was sacred to Helios, where he had flocks of oxen and sheep of 350 head each that never increased or decreased, tended by his daughters Phaetusa and Lampetia.
claims.statement_id: Pulau Thrinacia (Sisilia) keramat bagi Helios; di sana ia memiliki kawanan sapi dan domba masing-masing 350 ekor yang tidak pernah bertambah atau berkurang, dirawat putri-putrinya Phaetusa dan Lampetia.
claims.quote: The island of Thrinacia (Sicily) was sacred to Helios, and he there had flocks of oxen and sheep, each consisting of 350 heads, which never increased or decreased, and were attended to by his daughters Phaetusa and Lampetia.

claims.statement: The sacrifices offered to Helios consisted of white rams, boars, bulls, goats, lambs, especially white horses, and honey.
claims.statement_id: Persembahan kepada Helios berupa domba jantan putih, babi hutan, banteng, kambing, anak domba, terutama kuda putih, dan madu.
claims.quote: The sacrifices offered to Helios consisted of white rams, boars, bulls, goats, lambs, especially white horses, and honey.

claims.statement: Among the animals sacred to him, the cock is especially mentioned.
claims.statement_id: Di antara hewan yang keramat baginya, ayam jantan disebut secara khusus.
claims.quote: Among the animals sacred to him, the cock is especially mentioned.

claims.statement: Later poets make him sail in a golden boat round one-half of the earth to arrive at the point in the east from which he must rise again; this golden boat is the work of Hephaestus.
claims.statement_id: Penyair kemudian membuatnya berlayar dengan perahu emas mengelilingi separuh bumi hingga tiba di titik timur tempat ia terbit lagi; perahu emas itu buatan Hephaestus.
claims.quote: later poets make him sail in a golden boat round one-half of the earth, and thus arrive in the east at the point from which he has to rise again. This golden boat is the work of Hephaestus.

claims.statement: In Homeric Hymn 31, Helios's parents are Hyperion and Euryphaessa.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Homeric Hymn 31, orang tua Helios adalah Hyperion dan Euryphaessa.
claims.quote: [1.2] HYPERION & EURYPHAESSA (Homeric Hymn 31)

claims.statement: In Hyginus (Preface), Helios's parents are Hyperion and Aethra.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hyginus (Pref), orang tua Helios adalah Hyperion dan Aethra.
claims.quote: [1.3] HYPERION & AETHRA (Hyginus Pref)

claims.statement: Helios was famously the subject of the Colossus of Rhodes, the giant bronze statue considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.
claims.statement_id: Helios terkenal sebagai subjek Colossus of Rhodes, patung perunggu raksasa yang dianggap salah satu Tujuh Keajaiban Dunia Kuno.
claims.quote: Helios was famously the subject of the Colossus of Rhodes, the giant bronze statue considered one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

claims.statement: Hesiod tells in the Theogony that Helios had with Perseis, daughter of Ocean, two children, Circe and King Aietes, who ruled at Kolchis; Apollodorus later adds Pasiphae.
claims.statement_id: Hesiodos dalam Theogony menyebut bahwa Helios dengan Perseis, putri Ocean, memiliki dua anak, Circe dan raja Aietes yang memerintah di Kolchis; Apollodorus kemudian menambahkan Pasiphae.
claims.quote: Hesiod informs us in his Theogony that with Perseis, daughter of Ocean, he had two children, Circe and king Aietes, who ruled at Kolchis. Later, Apollodorus adds Pasiphae too.

claims.statement: The sacred cattle of Helios on Thrinacia were once stolen by the giant Alkyoneus, avenged by Hercules; later some of his flock were attacked and eaten by Odysseus' hungry comrades.
claims.statement_id: Sapi keramat Helios di Thrinacia pernah dicuri raksasa Alkyoneus dan dibalas oleh Hercules; kemudian sebagian kawanannya diserang dan dimakan kawan-kawan Odysseus yang kelaparan.
claims.quote: The famous sacred cattle of Helios, which he kept on Thrinacia (perhaps Sicily or Malta), were stolen once by the giant Alkyoneus, an outrageous act which was avenged by Hercules. Helios again had some of his flock attacked, and this time eaten too, by the hungry comrades of Odysseus

claims.statement: Fed up with the burning sun, Hercules threatened to shoot an arrow at Helios; instead of punishing him, the god rewarded his daring with a golden bowl that Hercules used to sail the seas in greater comfort.
claims.statement_id: Hercules yang jengkel pada terik matahari mengancam akan menembak Helios dengan panah; Helios tidak menghukumnya, melainkan menghadiahinya mangkuk emas yang ia pakai untuk berlayar lebih nyaman.
claims.quote: Fed up with the burning sun on his outward voyage, Hercules threatened to fire one of his arrows at Helios. The god, rather than punish Hercules for his petulance, rewarded his daring by gifting him a golden bowl which he used to sail the seas in greater comfort.

claims.statement: The Sun god shines on the amorous couple Aphrodite and Ares, revealing to Hephaistos his wife's illicit affair in the trap he had set.
claims.statement_id: Dewa Matahari menyinari pasangan Aphrodite dan Ares dan mengungkapkan kepada Hephaistos perselingkuhan istrinya dalam jebakan yang ia pasang.
claims.quote: The Sun god shines on the amorous couple Aphrodite and Ares revealing to Hephaistos the illicit shenanigans of his wife in the trap he had set.

claims.statement: In its founding mythology the island's name derives from the nymph Rhodos, who bore seven sons to Helios, the patron of the island.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi pendiriannya, nama pulau Rhodes berasal dari nimfa Rhodos yang melahirkan tujuh putra bagi Helios, pelindung pulau itu.
claims.quote: In its founding mythology, the name of the island derives from the nymph Rhodos who bore seven sons to Helios, the patron of the island.

claims.statement: Each year a chariot and four horses (quadriga) were thrown into the sea as an offering to the god.
claims.statement_id: Setiap tahun sebuah kereta dengan empat kuda (quadriga) dilemparkan ke laut sebagai persembahan bagi sang dewa.
claims.quote: each year a chariot and four horses (quadriga) were thrown into the sea as an offering to the god.

claims.statement: The god was not the subject of a wide-spread cult, but according to Plato many people, including Socrates, would greet the Sun and offer prayers each day.
claims.statement_id: Sang dewa bukan objek pemujaan yang meluas, tetapi menurut Plato banyak orang, termasuk Socrates, menyambut Matahari dan berdoa setiap hari.
claims.quote: The god was not the subject of a wide-spread cult, but Plato informs us in his Symposium and other works that many people, including Socrates, would greet the Sun and offer prayers each day.

claims.statement: The god Apollo was linked with the Sun from the 5th century BCE, and the association grew ever stronger from the Hellenistic period.
claims.statement_id: Dewa Apollo dikaitkan dengan Matahari sejak abad ke-5 SM, dan kaitan itu makin kuat sejak periode Helenistik.
claims.quote: The god Apollo was linked with the Sun from the 5th century BCE, and the association became ever stronger from the Hellenistic period

claims.statement: Helios appears in all forms of Greek and Roman art, usually depicted as a youth wearing a crown of sun rays.
claims.statement_id: Helios muncul dalam semua bentuk seni Yunani dan Romawi, biasanya sebagai pemuda bermahkota sinar matahari.
claims.quote: Helios appears in all forms of Greek and Roman art, where he is usually depicted as a youth wearing a crown of sun rays.

claims.statement: Rome's Circus Maximus had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna (the Moon) from the 3rd century BCE.
claims.statement_id: Circus Maximus di Roma memiliki kuil untuk Sol dan Luna (Bulan) sejak abad ke-3 SM.
claims.quote: Rome's Circus Maximus, for example, had a temple dedicated to Sol and Luna (the Moon) from the 3rd century BCE.

claims.statement: The Colossus was built between 304 and 280 BCE and toppled by an earthquake in either 228 or 226 BCE.
claims.statement_id: Colossus dibangun antara 304 dan 280 SM dan roboh oleh gempa pada 228 atau 226 SM.
claims.quote: Built between 304 and 280 BCE, it was toppled by an earthquake in either 228 or 226 BCE.

issues.message: 1 kutipan tidak bisa dicek otomatis: www.metmuseum.org (HTTP 429).

claims.statement: Oceanus is the eldest Titan and a child of Uranus and Gaia in Greek myth.
claims.statement_id: Oceanus adalah Titan tertua dan anak Uranus serta Gaia dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: Oceanus (also Okeanos) was the eldest of the Titans and a son of Uranus (Heaven) and Gaia (Earth) in Greek mythology.

claims.statement: Oceanus is god and personification of a freshwater river believed to encircle the earth.
claims.statement_id: Oceanus adalah dewa sekaligus personifikasi sungai air tawar yang dipercaya mengelilingi bumi.
claims.quote: He was the god and personification of the freshwater river Oceanus, which was thought to encircle the earth

claims.statement: Oceanus married Tethys, and their children were described as three thousand rivers and three thousand nymphs.
claims.statement_id: Oceanus menikah dengan Tethys; keturunan mereka dilukiskan sebagai tiga ribu sungai dan tiga ribu nimfa.
claims.quote: Oceanus was married to his sister, Tethys, and they had 3,000 sons together (the rivers of the earth) and 3,000 daughters (the nymphs of land and water).

claims.statement: Ancient Greeks believed the freshwater Oceanus river surrounded the world.
claims.statement_id: Orang Yunani kuno percaya sungai air tawar Oceanus mengelilingi dunia.
claims.quote: The ancient Greeks believed that the great freshwater river Oceanus surrounded the world.

claims.statement: Springs, wells, and rivers were believed to draw their water from Oceanus.
claims.statement_id: Mata air, sumur, dan sungai dipercaya memperoleh air dari Oceanus.
claims.quote: All the waters that flow from fountains, springs, wells, and rivers came from the mighty Oceanus.

claims.statement: Oceanus did not personally fight in the Titanomachy.
claims.statement_id: Oceanus tidak bertempur langsung dalam Titanomakhia.
claims.quote: Oceanus did not personally get involved in the Titanomachy – the conflict between the Titans and the Olympian gods

claims.statement: Oceanus sent his daughter Styx and her children to aid Zeus.
claims.statement_id: Oceanus mengirim putrinya Styx dan anak-anaknya membantu Zeus.
claims.quote: Oceanus sent his daughter Styx and her children to fight on Zeus' side during the revolt.

claims.statement: Greek art depicts Oceanus with a fish tail, human torso, and horned head.
claims.statement_id: Seni Yunani menggambarkan Oceanus dengan ekor ikan, tubuh manusia, dan kepala bertanduk.
claims.quote: Oceanus is depicted in Greek art with a long fishtail, a man's torso, and a horned head

claims.statement: The article states there is no evidence of a specific cult dedicated to Oceanus.
claims.statement_id: Artikel ini menyatakan tidak ada bukti kultus khusus bagi Oceanus.
claims.quote: there is no evidence that Oceanus ever had a cult or specific cult worship dedicated to him.

claims.statement: Theoi calls Oceanus the primordial Titan god of the earth-encircling river.
claims.statement_id: Theoi menyebut Oceanus dewa Titan purba bagi sungai yang mengelilingi bumi.
claims.quote: OKEANOS (Oceanus) was the primordial Titan god of the great, earth-encircling River Okeanos

claims.statement: The children of Oceanus and Tethys include the river gods Potamoi and the nymphs Okeanides.
claims.statement_id: Anak-anak Oceanus dan Tethys mencakup dewa sungai Potamoi serta nimfa Okeanides.
claims.quote: Their children were the Potamoi, gods of rivers, and the Okeanides (Oceanids), nymphs of springs and fountains.

claims.statement: Vase painting depicts Oceanus with bull horns and a serpentine fish tail.
claims.statement_id: Lukisan vas menampilkan Oceanus bertanduk banteng dan berekor ikan menyerupai ular.
claims.quote: Okeanos was depicted in ancient Greek vase painting as a bull-horned god with the tail of a serpentine fish

claims.statement: The Met also notes the Greek belief in a great encircling stream called Ocean.
claims.statement_id: The Met juga mencatat kepercayaan Yunani tentang arus besar Ocean yang mengelilingi bumi.
claims.quote: The ancient Greeks believed that there was a great, wide, flowing stream that surrounded the earth. They called the stream Ocean.

claims.statement: Okeanos was the font of all the earth's fresh water (rivers, wells, springs, and rain-clouds) and the god who regulated the heavenly bodies that rose from and set into his waters.
claims.statement_id: Okeanos adalah sumber seluruh air tawar bumi (sungai, sumur, mata air, dan awan hujan) dan dewa yang mengatur benda-benda langit yang terbit dari dan terbenam ke perairannya.
claims.quote: font of all of the earth's fresh-water - rivers, wells, springs and rain-clouds. He was also the god who regulated the heavenly bodies which rose from and set into his waters.

claims.statement: Unlike his Titan brothers, Okeanos did not take part in the castration of their father Ouranos nor join the war against Zeus and the Olympian gods.
claims.statement_id: Berbeda dari saudara-saudara Titannya, Okeanos tidak ikut mengebiri ayah mereka, Ouranos, dan tidak bergabung dalam perang melawan Zeus dan para dewa Olimpus.
claims.quote: Unlike his Titan-brothers Okeanos did not participate in the castration of their father Ouranos nor join the war against Zeus and the Olympian gods.

claims.statement: Okeanos was probably identical to Ophion, an elder Titan in the Orphic myths who ruled heaven briefly before being wrestled and cast into the Ocean stream by Kronos.
claims.statement_id: Okeanos mungkin identik dengan Ophion, Titan yang lebih tua dalam mitos Orfik yang sebentar memerintah langit sebelum dikalahkan dan dilempar ke aliran Ocean oleh Kronos.
claims.quote: Okeanos was probably identical to Ophion, an elder Titan in the Orphic myths who ruled heaven briefly before being wrestled and cast into the Ocean stream by Kronos (Cronus).

claims.statement: His usual attributes were a fish and serpent.
claims.statement_id: Atribut yang lazim bagi Okeanos adalah ikan dan ular.
claims.quote: His usual attributes were a fish and serpent.

claims.statement: In the Hellenistic era Okeanos was reimagined as the god of the increasingly accessible Atlantic and Indian Oceans, and the old cosmological idea of an earth-encircling fresh-water stream was discarded.
claims.statement_id: Pada era Helenistik, Okeanos dibayangkan ulang sebagai dewa Samudra Atlantik dan Hindia yang makin mudah dijangkau, dan gagasan kosmologis lama tentang aliran air tawar yang mengelilingi bumi ditinggalkan.
claims.quote: In the Hellenistic era, Okeanos was reimagined as the god of the then increasingly accessible Atlantic and Indian Oceans, and the old cosmological idea of a great, earth-encircling, fresh-water stream was discarded.

claims.statement: In mosaic art he is usually depicted as a sea-god or the sea itself personified, with crab-claw horns and, as attributes, a serpent, oar, and school of fish.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni mozaik ia biasanya digambarkan sebagai dewa laut atau laut yang dipersonifikasikan, bertanduk capit kepiting, dengan atribut ular, dayung, dan kawanan ikan.
claims.quote: In mosaic art he is therefore usually depicted as a sea-god or the sea itself personified, with crab-claw horns, and for attributes, a serpent, oar and school of fish.

claims.statement: Okeanos' wife Tethys "the Nurse" was probably envisioned distributing his nourishing waters across the earth through subterranean aquifers.
claims.statement_id: Istri Okeanos, Tethys "Sang Pengasuh", mungkin dibayangkan membagikan air penghidupannya ke seluruh bumi melalui akuifer bawah tanah.
claims.quote: Okeanos' wife Tethys "the Nurse" was probably envisioned distributing his nourishing waters across the earth through subterranean acquifers.

claims.statement: In the Homeric poems he appears as a mighty god who yields to none save Zeus.
claims.statement_id: Dalam puisi Homerik, Okeanos tampil sebagai dewa perkasa yang tidak tunduk kepada siapa pun kecuali Zeus.
claims.quote: In the Homeric poems he appears as a mighty god, who yields to none save Zeus.

claims.statement: Homer does not mention his parentage but calls Tethys his wife, by whom he had three daughters, Thetis, Eurynome, and Perse.
claims.statement_id: Homer tidak menyebut orang tuanya, tetapi menyebut Tethys istrinya dan mereka memiliki tiga putri: Thetis, Eurynome, dan Perse.
claims.quote: Homer does not mention his parentage, but calls Tethys his wife, by whom he had three daughters, Thetis, Eurynome and Perse.

claims.statement: In Hyginus (Preface), Oceanus's parents are Aither (or Ouranos) and Gaia.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Hyginus (Preface), orang tua Oceanus adalah Aither (atau Ouranos) dan Gaia.
claims.quote: [1.2] AITHER (or OURANOS) & GAIA (Hyginus Preface)

claims.statement: Oceanus was said to dwell on the western shores of the earth and never left his home, not even to attend the assemblies of the gods.
claims.statement_id: Oceanus dikatakan tinggal di tepi barat bumi dan tidak pernah meninggalkan rumahnya, bahkan untuk menghadiri sidang para dewa.
claims.quote: He was said to dwell on the western shores of the earth and never left his home, not even to attend the assemblies of the gods.

claims.statement: The river Oceanus was thought to encircle the earth and was said to be the source of all living gods and creatures; in early mythology, however, Oceanus was often viewed as an element rather than a god.
claims.statement_id: Sungai Oceanus dianggap mengelilingi bumi dan dikatakan sumber semua dewa dan makhluk hidup; namun dalam mitologi awal Oceanus sering dipandang sebagai unsur, bukan dewa.
claims.quote: which was thought to encircle the earth and was said to be the source of all living gods and creatures. However, in early mythology, Oceanus was often viewed as an element rather than a god.

claims.statement: Because he did not fight, Oceanus did not share the dreadful fate of imprisonment in Tartarus; as a reward he was allowed to rule over Oceanus in undisturbed peace.
claims.statement_id: Karena tidak ikut bertempur, Oceanus tidak mengalami nasib buruk dipenjara di Tartarus; sebagai ganjaran ia dibiarkan memerintah Oceanus dengan damai.
claims.quote: so he did not share their dreadful fate of being imprisoned in Tartarus (the deepest part of the underworld). As a reward, Oceanus was allowed to rule over Oceanus in undisturbed peace.

claims.statement: To stop Hercules from reaching his grandson, Oceanus caused great waves to overcome the golden vessel Hercules clung to; Hercules drew his bow and frightened Oceanus into calming the waters so he could reach Erytheia safely.
claims.statement_id: Untuk menghentikan Hercules mencapai cucunya, Oceanus menimbulkan ombak besar yang menimpa kapal emas tempat Hercules berpegangan; Hercules menarik busurnya dan menakuti Oceanus hingga menenangkan air sehingga ia tiba dengan selamat di Erytheia.
claims.quote: In an attempt to stop Hercules from reaching his grandson, Oceanus caused great waves to overcome the golden vessel that Hercules clung to. Hercules drew his bow and frightened Oceanus into calming the waters so he could reach Erytheia safely.

claims.statement: In Prometheus Bound, Prometheus, Titan god of fire and brother and son-in-law to Oceanus, lies chained to a rock as Zeus's punishment after giving fire to humankind.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Prometheus Bound, Prometheus, Titan api dan saudara sekaligus menantu Oceanus, terbelenggu pada batu sebagai hukuman Zeus setelah memberi api kepada manusia.
claims.quote: In Prometheus Bound, Prometheus, the Titan god of fire and brother and son-in-law to Oceanus, lies chained to a rock as punishment from Zeus after Prometheus gave fire to humankind

claims.statement: Oceanus travels to where Prometheus lies in chains and sympathises with his plight, saying that even beyond their blood relation there is nobody he is more fond of.
claims.statement_id: Oceanus mendatangi Prometheus yang terbelenggu dan bersimpati pada nasibnya, mengatakan bahwa di luar hubungan darah pun tak ada yang lebih ia sayangi.
claims.quote: Oceanus travels to where Prometheus lies in chains and sympathised with his plight, telling him that even beyond their blood relation, there is nobody he is more fond of.

claims.statement: The chorus is sung by Oceanus' many children, who welcome their father as he enters on a giant bird, most likely a griffin.
claims.statement_id: Paduan suara dinyanyikan banyak anak Oceanus yang menyambut ayah mereka, yang masuk ke panggung dengan menunggang burung raksasa, kemungkinan griffin.
claims.quote: The chorus is sung by Oceanus' many children who step onto the stage to welcome their father, who enters on a giant bird, most likely a griffin.

claims.statement: Oceanus and Tethys purged Glaucus of all his mortal characteristics and performed a ritual cleansing.
claims.statement_id: Oceanus dan Tethys membersihkan Glaucus dari seluruh sifat fananya dan melakukan ritual penyucian.
claims.quote: Glaucus was a fisherman who was transformed into a sea god. ... with Oceanus and Tethys purging him of all his mortal characteristics and performing a ritual cleansing.

claims.statement: As described in the Iliad, Oceanus is featured on Achilles' shield, made by Hephaestus; the Oceanus river is shown on the shield's edges, surrounding all the other images.
claims.statement_id: Seperti dalam Iliad, Oceanus tampil pada perisai Achilles buatan Hephaestus; sungai Oceanus ditunjukkan di tepi perisai, mengelilingi semua gambar lainnya.
claims.quote: As described in the Iliad, Oceanus is featured on Achilles' shield, which Hephaestus, the god of metallurgy, made. The Oceanus river was shown on the shield's edges, surrounding all the other images depicted on the shield.

claims.statement: In art he holds a sceptre to represent his power and rides a sea creature alone or beside his wife Tethys.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni Yunani ia memegang tongkat kerajaan sebagai lambang kekuasaan dan menunggang makhluk laut, sendiri atau di samping istrinya, Tethys.
claims.quote: He holds a sceptre to represent his power and rides on a sea creature alone or by the side of his wife, Tethys.

claims.statement: Oceanus is featured in The Orphic Hymns and has an Orphic Hymn dedicated to him, in which he is called the creator of mortal men and gods.
claims.statement_id: Oceanus tampil dalam Himne-himne Orfik dan memiliki satu himne khusus; dalam himne itu ia disebut pencipta manusia fana dan para dewa.
claims.quote: He is, however, featured in The Orphic Hymns and has an Orphic Hymn dedicated to him. In the hymn, he is mentioned as being the creator of mortal men and gods.

claims.statement: Oceanus was given the ultimate honour of having the largest body of saltwater that encircles the earth named after him.
claims.statement_id: Oceanus mendapat kehormatan tertinggi: badan air asin terbesar yang mengelilingi bumi dinamai dengan namanya.
claims.quote: Oceanus was given the ultimate honour of having the largest body of saltwater that encircles the earth named after him

claims.statement: On the far side of Oceanus lay strange, mysterious places like the Garden of the Hesperides and the island of Erytheia.
claims.statement_id: Di seberang Oceanus terletak tempat-tempat aneh dan misterius seperti Taman Hesperides dan pulau Erytheia.
claims.quote: On the far side of Oceanus lay strange, mysterious places like the Garden of the Hesperides and the island of Erytheia.

claims.statement: Their best-known children were the River Styx, Inachos the king of Argos, and the Oceanids Eurynome, Electra, Metis, and Theia.
claims.statement_id: Anak-anak mereka yang paling terkenal adalah Sungai Styx, Inachos raja Argos, dan para Oceanid Eurynome, Electra, Metis, dan Theia.
claims.quote: Their most well-known children were the River Styx (the barrier between earth and the underworld), Inachos, the king of Argos, and the Oceanids Eurynome, Electra, Metis (Zeus' first notable wife), and Theia.

claims.statement: His siblings include Cronus, Hyperion, Mnemosyne, Rhea, Tethys, and Themis.
claims.statement_id: Saudara-saudaranya antara lain Cronus, Hyperion, Mnemosyne, Rhea, Tethys, dan Themis.
claims.quote: His siblings include Cronus, Hyperion, Mnemosyne, Rhea, Tethys, and Themis.

claims.statement: Helios, the sun god, lived in the east, near the banks of Oceanus.
claims.statement_id: Helios, dewa matahari, tinggal di timur dekat tepi Oceanus.
claims.quote: Helios, the sun god, lived in the east, near the banks of Oceanus.

claims.statement: Selene is the Greek goddess and personification of the moon.
claims.statement_id: Selene adalah dewi sekaligus personifikasi bulan dalam mitologi Yunani.
claims.quote: Selene (also known as Mene) is the personification and goddess of the moon in Greek mythology.

claims.statement: Each night Selene is said to cross the sky in her chariot.
claims.statement_id: Setiap malam Selene dikisahkan melintasi langit dengan keretanya.
claims.quote: Every night, she travels across the sky in her chariot, pulling the moon behind her.

claims.statement: Selene is the daughter of Hyperion and Theia and sister of Helios and Eos.
claims.statement_id: Selene adalah putri Hyperion dan Theia serta saudari Helios dan Eos.
claims.quote: Selene is the daughter of the Titans Hyperion and Theia and the sister of Helios (Sun) and Eos (Dawn).

claims.statement: Luna is Selene's Roman counterpart.
claims.statement_id: Luna adalah padanan Selene dalam tradisi Romawi.
claims.quote: The Roman counterpart of Selene is Luna.

claims.statement: Selene's moon chariot is drawn by silver-white horses or sometimes oxen.
claims.statement_id: Kereta bulan Selene ditarik sepasang kuda putih keperakan atau kadang sepasang lembu.
claims.quote: Selene's moon chariot was pulled across the night sky by a pair of white-silvery horses or sometimes by a pair of oxen.

claims.statement: Greek art often depicts Selene with a crescent crown and no wings.
claims.statement_id: Dalam seni Yunani, Selene kerap dimahkotai bulan sabit dan tanpa sayap.
claims.quote: In Greek art, Selene was usually depicted with a crescent moon crown and without wings.

claims.statement: Selene's best-known story concerns her love for Endymion.
claims.statement_id: Kisah paling terkenal Selene berkaitan dengan cintanya kepada Endymion.
claims.quote: The best-known story involving Selene is her love affair with the beautiful youth Endymion.

claims.statement: In one account Selene and Endymion have fifty daughters.
claims.statement_id: Dalam satu kisah, Selene dan Endymion memiliki lima puluh putri.
claims.quote: Selene bore Endymion 50 daughters.

claims.statement: Some sources say Selene asked Zeus to grant Endymion ageless perpetual sleep.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian sumber menyatakan Selene meminta Zeus membuat Endymion tidur abadi agar tidak menua atau mati.
claims.quote: According to some sources, Selene begged Zeus to grant Endymion perpetual sleep, so he would not age or die

claims.statement: Other sources say Endymion chose the perpetual sleep himself.
claims.statement_id: Sumber lain menyebut Endymion sendiri memilih tidur abadi.
claims.quote: Other sources state that Endymion chose it for himself

claims.statement: Theoi calls Selene the Titan moon goddess.
claims.statement_id: Theoi menyebut Selene dewi Titan bulan.
claims.quote: SELENE was the Titan goddess of the moon.

claims.statement: Selene's crescent can appear as a crown or the fold of a raised shining cloak.
claims.statement_id: Bulan sabit dapat menjadi mahkota Selene atau bagian jubah bercahaya yang terangkat.
claims.quote: Her lunar sphere or crescent was either a crown set upon her head or the fold of a raised, shining cloak.

claims.statement: A Roman sarcophagus shows Selene leaving her chariot to visit the reclining Endymion.
claims.statement_id: Sarkofagus Romawi menampilkan Selene turun dari kereta untuk menemui Endymion yang berbaring.
claims.quote: In the center, Selene, the moon goddess, alights from her chariot to visit her beloved, the shepherd Endymion, who reclines at the right.

claims.statement: The Endymion story is carved on the front of the sarcophagus.
claims.statement_id: Kisah Endymion dipahat pada bagian depan sarkofagus.
claims.quote: The story of Endymion is shown in strongly undercut relief on the front of the sarcophagus.

claims.statement: Selene was depicted as a woman riding sidesaddle on a horse or driving a chariot drawn by a pair of winged steeds.
claims.statement_id: Selene digambarkan sebagai perempuan yang menunggang kuda menyamping atau mengendarai kereta yang ditarik sepasang kuda bersayap.
claims.quote: She was depicted as a woman riding sidesaddle on a horse or driving a chariot drawn by a pair of winged steeds.

claims.statement: Endymion was granted eternal youth and immortality by Zeus and placed in eternal slumber in a cave near the peak of Lydian Mount Latmos; his heavenly bride consorted with him there at night.
claims.statement_id: Endymion diberi kemudaan abadi dan keabadian oleh Zeus serta ditempatkan dalam tidur abadi di sebuah gua dekat puncak Gunung Latmos di Lydia; mempelai surgawinya menemuinya di sana pada malam hari.
claims.quote: Selene's great love was the shepherd prince Endymion. The beautiful boy was granted eternal youth and immortality by Zeus and placed in a state of eternal slumber in a cave near the peak of Lydian Mount Latmos (Latmus). His heavenly bride consorted with him there in the night.

claims.statement: Other Greek moon goddesses included Pasiphae, the Leukippides, Eileithyia, Hekate, Artemis, Bendis, and Hera (who sometimes doubled for Selene in the Endymion myth).
claims.statement_id: Dewi bulan Yunani lainnya mencakup Pasiphae, Leukippides, Eileithyia, Hekate, Artemis, Bendis, dan Hera (yang kadang menggantikan Selene dalam mitos Endymion).
claims.quote: Other Greek moon goddesses included Pasiphae, the Leukippides (Leucippes), Eileithyia, Hekate (Hecate), Artemis, Bendis, and Hera (who sometimes doubled for Selene in the Endymion myth).

claims.statement: In Homeric Hymn 31 to Helios, Selene's parents are Hyperion and Euryphaessa.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Homeric Hymn 31 to Helios, orang tua Selene adalah Hyperion dan Euryphaessa.
claims.quote: [1.2] HYPERION & EURYPHAESSA (Homeric Hymn 31 to Helios)

claims.statement: In Homeric Hymn 4 to Hermes 100, Pallas is listed as Selene's parent.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Homeric Hymn 4 to Hermes 100, Pallas dicantumkan sebagai orang tua Selene.
claims.quote: [2.1] PALLAS (Homeric Hymn 4 to Hermes 100

claims.statement: She is also called Phoebe, as the sister of Phoebus, the god of the sun.
claims.statement_id: Selene juga disebut Phoebe, sebagai saudari Phoebus, dewa matahari.
claims.quote: She is also called Phoebe, as the sister of Phoebus, the god of the sun.

claims.statement: By Endymion, whom she loved and sent to sleep in order to kiss him, Selene became the mother of fifty daughters.
claims.statement_id: Dari Endymion, yang ia cintai dan ia tidurkan agar dapat menciumnya, Selene menjadi ibu lima puluh putri.
claims.quote: By Endymion, whom she loved, and whom she sent to sleep in order to kiss him, she became the mother of fifty daughters

claims.statement: By Zeus, Selene became the mother of Pandeia, Ersa, and Nemea.
claims.statement_id: Dari Zeus, Selene menjadi ibu Pandeia, Ersa, dan Nemea.
claims.quote: by Zeus she became the mother of Pandeia, Ersa, and Nemea

claims.statement: Selene is described as a very beautiful goddess with long wings and a golden diadem.
claims.statement_id: Selene digambarkan sebagai dewi yang sangat cantik, bersayap panjang, dan bermahkota emas.
claims.quote: Selene is described as a very beautiful goddess, with long wings and a golden diadem

claims.statement: Aeschylus calls her the eye of night.
claims.statement_id: Aeschylus menyebutnya mata malam.
claims.quote: Aeschylus (Sept. 390) calls her the eye of night.

claims.statement: Like her brother Helios, she rode across the heavens in a chariot drawn by two white horses, cows, or mules.
claims.statement_id: Seperti saudaranya Helios, ia melintasi langit dengan kereta yang ditarik dua ekor kuda putih, sapi, atau begal.
claims.quote: She rode, like her brother Helios, across the heavens in a chariot drawn by two white horses, cows, or mules

claims.statement: In later times Selene was identified with Artemis, and the worship of the two became amalgamated.
claims.statement_id: Pada masa kemudian Selene diidentikkan dengan Artemis, dan pemujaan keduanya melebur.
claims.quote: In later times Selene was identified with Artemis, and the worship of the two became amalgamated

claims.statement: In works of art the two divinities are usually distinguished: Selene's face is fuller and rounder, her figure less tall, and she is always clothed in a long robe.
claims.statement_id: Dalam karya seni keduanya biasanya dibedakan: wajah Selene lebih penuh dan bulat, tubuhnya kurang tinggi, dan selalu berjubah panjang.
claims.quote: In works of art, however, the two divinities are usually distinguished; the face of Selene being more full and round, her figure less tall, and always clothed in a long robe

claims.statement: At Elis there was a statue of Selene with two horns.
claims.statement_id: Di Elis ada patung Selene dengan dua tanduk.
claims.quote: at Elis there was a statue of her with two horns

claims.statement: At Rome Luna had a temple on the Aventine.
claims.statement_id: Di Roma, Luna memiliki kuil di bukit Aventine.
claims.quote: At Rome Luna had a temple on the Aventine.

claims.statement: Selene, meaning "the moon", was depicted as a beautiful woman with long wings and a gold crown.
claims.statement_id: Selene, yang berarti "bulan", digambarkan sebagai perempuan cantik bersayap panjang dan bermahkota emas.
claims.quote: Selene, meaning "the moon", was depicted as a beautiful woman with long wings and a gold crown.

claims.statement: Selene is commonly associated with the fellow Greek goddesses Artemis and Hecate.
claims.statement_id: Selene biasanya dikaitkan dengan sesama dewi Yunani, Artemis dan Hecate.
claims.quote: She is commonly associated with the fellow Greek goddesses Artemis and Hecate.

claims.statement: Selene has two daughters with Zeus: Pandia, whom the Athenians honoured every full moon, and Ersa (Herse), the personification of the dew.
claims.statement_id: Selene memiliki dua putri dengan Zeus: Pandia, yang dihormati orang Athena setiap bulan purnama, dan Ersa (Herse), personifikasi embun.
claims.quote: Selene has two daughters with Zeus; Pandia (who the Athenians honoured every full moon) and Ersa (Herse), the personification of the dew.

claims.statement: In the Homeric Hymn to Selene she is described as a kindly and beautiful winged goddess crowned with gold who drives her chariot across the night sky as a sign to humans.
claims.statement_id: Dalam Homeric Hymn to Selene, ia digambarkan sebagai dewi bersayap yang ramah dan cantik, bermahkota emas, yang mengendarai keretanya melintasi langit malam sebagai tanda bagi manusia.
claims.quote: In the Homeric Hymn to Selene, Selene is described as a kindly and beautiful winged goddess who is crowned with gold and drives her chariot across the night sky as a sign to humans.

claims.statement: The moon's phases set the schedule of religious festivals through the year and symbolised the cycles of birth and death, and the ancient Greeks measured time in lunar months.
claims.statement_id: Fase-fase bulan menentukan jadwal festival keagamaan sepanjang tahun dan melambangkan siklus kelahiran dan kematian, dan orang Yunani kuno mengukur waktu dalam bulan lunar.
claims.quote: The moon's phases created the schedule of religious festivals celebrated throughout the year and symbolised the cycles of birth and death, with the ancient Greeks measuring out time in lunar months.

claims.statement: During the Classical Period it was a popular belief that witches could bring the moon down from the sky, linking Selene to witchcraft.
claims.statement_id: Pada Periode Klasik ada kepercayaan populer bahwa penyihir dapat menurunkan bulan dari langit, yang mengaitkan Selene dengan sihir.
claims.quote: Another popular belief during the Classical Period was that witches could bring the moon down from the sky, linking Selene to witchcraft

claims.statement: The only time Selene stopped pulling the moon across the night sky was at the orders of Hera and Zeus during the Giants' Revolt (Gigantomachy) against the Olympians.
claims.statement_id: Satu-satunya saat Selene berhenti menarik bulan melintasi langit malam adalah atas perintah Hera dan Zeus pada Pemberontakan Para Raksasa (Gigantomakhia) melawan para dewa Olimpus.
claims.quote: The only time Selene stopped pulling the moon across the night sky was at the orders of Hera and Zeus during the Giants' Revolt (Gigantomachy) against the Olympians.

claims.statement: According to Nonnus, the monstrous serpent Typhon attacked Selene during his revolt against the heavens; Selene remained undaunted, struggled with Typhon, locking horns with him and scarring the orb of her bull's horn.
claims.statement_id: Menurut Nonnus, ular raksasa Typhon menyerang Selene dalam pemberontakannya terhadap langit; Selene tetap tak gentar, bergulat dengan Typhon, mengadu tanduk, dan melukai bola tanduk banteng miliknya.
claims.quote: According to the Greek epic poet Nonnus (5th century CE) in his Dionysiaca, the monstrous serpent Typhon attacked Selene during his revolt against the heavens. He launched bulls at her, but she remained undaunted even after he charged at her. Selene struggled with Typhon, locking horns with him and scarring the orb of her bull's horn.

claims.statement: Selene spotted the shepherd Endymion sleeping on a hill near Mount Latmos; overcome by his beauty, she waited for the new moon, when her chariot would not be seen, and flew down to lie with him as he slept.
claims.statement_id: Selene melihat gembala Endymion tidur di bukit dekat Gunung Latmos; terpikat oleh keindahannya, ia menunggu bulan baru agar keretanya tak terlihat lalu turun untuk berbaring bersamanya saat ia tidur.
claims.quote: Selene spotted the shepherd Endymion sleeping on a hill near Mount Latmos. Overcome by his beauty, she waited for the new moon when her chariot would not be seen and flew down to lie with him as he slept.

claims.statement: Others say that it was Selene's punishment from Zeus for being absent from the skies.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian lain mengatakan tidur itu adalah hukuman Zeus bagi Selene karena absen dari langit.
claims.quote: while some say that it was Selene's punishment from Zeus for being absent from the skies.

claims.statement: Not realising his true identity, Selene climbed onto Pan's back and permitted him to do whatever he wanted to her.
claims.statement_id: Tanpa menyadari jati dirinya, Selene naik ke punggung Pan dan membiarkannya berbuat sesukanya.
claims.quote: The mischievous god Pan disguised himself by covering his short, coarse black goat hair with soft, clean white fleece. Not realising his true identity, Selene climbed onto his back and permitted him to do whatever he wanted to her.

claims.statement: Ampelos foolishly claimed to be better at riding a wild bull than Selene at riding her horned moon; Selene sent a gadfly that stung the wild bull Ampelos was riding.
claims.statement_id: Ampelos dengan bodoh mengatakan ia lebih pandai menunggang banteng liar daripada Selene menunggang bulan bertanduknya; Selene mengirim pikat lalat yang menyengat banteng yang ditunggangi Ampelos.
claims.quote: One day, he foolishly stated that he was better at riding a wild bull than Selene was at riding her horned moon. Selene chose his punishment carefully. She sent down a gadfly that stung the wild bull Ampelos was riding.

claims.statement: Zeus instructed Hypnos to make all humans so tired they would not notice that Helios did not rise and that Selene moved extra slowly across the night sky, dragging out the night.
claims.statement_id: Zeus menyuruh Hypnos membuat semua manusia begitu lelah hingga tak sadar Helios tidak terbit dan Selene bergerak sangat lambat di langit malam sehingga malam diperpanjang.
claims.quote: Zeus had fallen in love with the human Alcmene. To be able to visit her, he needed a long night to ensure that he went unseen. He instructed Hypnos (Sleep) to make all humans so tired that they would not notice that Helios (Sun) did not rise and that Selene moved extra slowly across the night sky, dragging out the night.

claims.statement: Selene is also credited with creating the ferocious Nemean Lion, whom Heracles faced in his first labour.
claims.statement_id: Selene juga disebut sebagai pencipta Singa Nemea yang ganas, yang dihadapi Heracles pada tugas pertamanya.
claims.quote: Selene is also credited with creating the ferocious Nemean Lion, whom Heracles faced in his first labour.

claims.statement: Some traditions say Selene bore the lion with a shudder and dropped it to earth near Nemea by a two-mouthed cave, where she made it prey upon her own people as punishment for an unfulfilled sacrifice.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian tradisi menyebut Selene melahirkan singa itu dengan gemetar dan menjatuhkannya ke bumi dekat Nemea di gua bermulut dua, tempat ia membuatnya memangsa rakyatnya sendiri sebagai hukuman atas kurban yang tak dipenuhi.
claims.quote: Some traditions state that Selene bore the lion with a shudder and dropped it to earth near Nemea by a two-mouthed cave, where she made the creature prey upon her own people as punishment for an unfulfilled sacrifice.

claims.statement: Other sources say that in answer to Hera's wishes Selene created the lion from sea foam, which was then bound and carried to the Nemean mountains by Iris.
claims.statement_id: Sumber lain mengatakan bahwa atas keinginan Hera, Selene menciptakan singa itu dari buih laut yang lalu diikat dan dibawa ke pegunungan Nemea oleh Iris.
claims.quote: Other sources say that in answer to Hera's wishes, Selene created the lion from sea foam which was then bound and carried to the Nemean mountains by Iris

claims.statement: Pausanias mentions a stone image of a horned Selene in the agora of Elis in southern Greece.
claims.statement_id: Pausanias menyebut patung batu Selene bertanduk di agora Elis di Yunani selatan.
claims.quote: In his Description of Greece, the Greek geographer Pausanias (c. 115 to c. 180 CE) talks about a stone image of a horned Selene in Elis' agora (open-air marketplace) in southern Greece.

claims.statement: Moon-shaped cakes were made in honour of Selene.
claims.statement_id: Kue berbentuk bulan dibuat untuk menghormati Selene.
claims.quote: Moon-shaped cakes were made in honour of Selene.

claims.statement: The poet Pindar stated that men in love prayed to the sun (Helios), while women in love prayed to the moon (Selene).
claims.statement_id: Penyair Pindar menyatakan bahwa pria yang jatuh cinta berdoa kepada matahari (Helios), sedangkan wanita yang jatuh cinta berdoa kepada bulan (Selene).
claims.quote: Greek poet Pindar (c. 518 to c. 448 BCE) stated that men in love prayed to the sun (Helios), while women in love prayed to the moon (Selene).

claims.statement: The work shows Helios' chariot rising on the eastern horizon while on the other side Selene and her horses sink in the west, symbolising their connection with the passing of time.
claims.statement_id: Karya itu menunjukkan kereta Helios naik di ufuk timur sementara di sisi lain Selene dan kuda-kudanya tenggelam di barat, melambangkan kaitan mereka dengan berlalunya waktu.
claims.quote: It shows Helios' chariot rising up on the eastern horizon (the sun rising), while on the other side, Selene and her horses are shown sinking over the west, symbolising their connection with the passing of time.

claims.statement: The chemical element selenium was named after Selene in 1818 by a Swedish chemist.
claims.statement_id: Unsur kimia selenium dinamai dari Selene pada 1818 oleh seorang ahli kimia Swedia.
claims.quote: In chemistry, the chemical element selenium was named after Selene in 1818 by the Swedish chemist
